'''Ira Myers''' (also published as '''Ira Mayers''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam]] on 4 March 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops]] and Harvest-ish, according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d314">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-06-stitches-florida-gs-p1-march-400d314/ stitches-florida-gs-p1-march-400], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 6 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-06-stitches-florida-gs-p1-march-400d314/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played at [[October 1999 Boca Raton tournament]] on 31 October 1999 with Tatooine/CC Mains & Toys, according to Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d95">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-05-boca-raton-florida-10-31-99d95/ boca-raton-florida-10-31-99], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 5 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-05-boca-raton-florida-10-31-99d95/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
